variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick keeps the north gate, shut by Halvard against Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Hardly anybody comes up to this gate these days.

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: Back to town with you, stranger! Have a pleasant day!

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Very well. It's open. Go on.

variants.specifics: Dolgar: Durm guards the way down to the Old Shaft, shut by Foreman Brask since Krell's Trolls took the Deep Gate.

first.speaker: Durm
first.text:
I'd go see Foreman Brask first...
unless you'd like to feel his boot.

again.speaker: Durm
again.text: Foreman Brask, I've brought you another volunteer who hopes to make a name for himself in the Deep!

later.speaker: Durm
later.text: Brask sent you down after the Trolls!? You're doomed! Go on, then! I won't miss you!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: Tobb at the Causeway gate, shut while Mogrut's Ogres hold the Sluice Tower.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: What's this? The Causeway gate is shut by order! You'd better go see Mayor Dobbet if you mean to cross. The Ogres are out there.

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text: Wanna spend a night in the stocks?

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Fair work at the Sluice Tower. But that don't make you one of the Bog Wardens! Now move along!

variants.specifics: Korlen: Corporal Fisk at the castle gate, later sent to fetch the player to Commander Dorvik after Skarn Tower is taken.

first.speaker: Fisk
first.text: Hey, you could do with a proper helmet.

again.speaker: Fisk
again.text: Utterly hopeless! Off with you, worm!

later.speaker: Fisk
later.text: Stand where you are, stranger! Commander Dorvik hears you threw the Ogres out of Skarn Tower and half the garrison swears to it! Come along. He's got a hot supper and a soft bed all ready for you! Will you come quietly, stranger?

variants.specifics: Ondel: Tobb, the warden at the jetty gate, shut since the Undead rose, and Maudie accuses the player of untying her boat.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: Only fishermen go down to the boats!

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text:
Hold it right there! Maudie swears you tried to untie her boat and the cut rope proves it.

Come along! I've got a damp and snug little cellar waiting for you.

Will you come quietly, stranger?

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Up out of that cellar, lad! Unless you'd RATHER stay down there!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Brusk, the guard at the College gate, shut since the Ghosts came.

later.speaker: Brusk
later.text: I hear Archivist Umbrik's reading room was full of bats till just lately. Funny business all over town nowadays.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: Haddo, guard at the north gate of Fort Skarra, before and after the Undead attack on the wall.

first.speaker: Haddo
first.text: You're mighty thin for these mountains.

later.speaker: Haddo
later.text: Vaskor must have found a way to wake the frozen dead. One night the east wall was quiet and by morning it was overrun with skeletons and zombies! They want the pass.

variants.specifics: Vurn: Durk, the guard at the Hall of Anvils, before and after the Helm of Far Sight is brought back.

again.speaker: Durk
again.text: Welcome to the Hall of Anvils. Master Kolbrin's workshop is at the back.

later.speaker: Durk
later.text: Word is you got the Helm back from those thieving Imps! Bless you, stranger!

variants.specifics: Varrow: Brannoc keeps the north gate, shut by Mayor Grumwald while Krull's bandits rob the north road; later the wolves come into town.

first.speaker: Brannoc
first.text: Greetings! My name is Brannoc. I guard this gate so nobody wanders up the north road and gets robbed blind.

again.speaker: Brannoc
again.text: Krull's thugs are prowling all along the north road! You'd best stay inside!

variants.specifics: Tolm: Dorrik keeps the east gate, shut by Mayor Corbel while the Ogres raid the fields.

first.speaker: Dorrik
first.text: Mayor Corbel has shut the east gate until somebody chases the Ogres out of the bean fields. Somebody ought to go and get Zelna. She usually just puts the Ogres to sleep instead of fighting them.

again.speaker: Dorrik
again.text: I'm afraid old Hobb has finally lost his wits. They've put me on his gate now that he's taken up sleeping in the hayloft and hooting at the moon all night.

later.speaker: Dorrik
later.text: We must save the granary! Drive back the Ogres and shut the east gate.
